changelog:
Initial release of sherpa-onnx-tts-local

- Provides offline, local text-to-speech using sherpa-onnx CLI.
- Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Installs platform-specific runtimes and a default English (US, Lessac) model.
- Requires configuring environment variables for runtime and model paths.
- CLI wrapper included for easy TTS synthesis without cloud dependencies.
summary: Local text-to-speech via sherpa-onnx (offline, no cloud)
